extra.reason: Implemented Go module, agentsh/agentshd entry points, workspace resolution, Unix-socket protocol, lazy daemon startup, health/shutdown lifecycle, stale/live socket handling, and tests.

Implemented Turso/libSQL local-first storage with optional embedded replica configuration, durable invocation lifecycle and FTS schema, daemon restart reconciliation, and separate content-addressed stream blob writers with deduplication. Added tests and daemon initialization.

Implemented Bash RPC/CLI execution with bash --noprofile --norc and pipefail, mandatory environment hygiene, fd 3 reservation, null/default or supplied stdin, durable records, separate blob streams, foreground/background execution, timeout and explicit process-group signaling, grace/SIGKILL cleanup, and exit reason mapping. Added process-tree, stream, environment, and background tests.

Implemented bounded head/tail previews with explicit byte/line/range metadata and literal recovery calls, uncapped content-addressed stream storage, BashOutput RPC and CLI retrieval, line ranges, regex grep/context with line numbers, running-stream snapshots, and non-clean recovery hints. Added and passed a 500MB stream fixture.

Completed MVP dogfood checkpoint, documented scenarios/findings/context behavior in issue notes, fixed the discovered background invocation data race, and passed race tests plus manual realistic workflows.

Implemented auto-detected per-invocation cgroup v2 containment, atomic/pre-command attachment, whole-cgroup kill, cleanup, OOM event mapping, fallback to process groups, and Linux integration tests validated in the Podman machine.
Implemented interactivity and stdin-wait detection, prompt blocker early return to caller, BashInput and BashKill RPC routes, and unit/race tests.
Implemented session management, state serialization and restoration via control FD 3, cwd/env deltas, functions and options carry-forward, BashState RPC, and concurrency/session isolation tests.

Implemented history filters (session, FTS command, exit, since, limit), verbatim replay operation, live process listing and kill/input/state APIs, blob GC by age/size, and RPC routes with storage tests.

Implemented agentshd mcp stdio transport, typed Bash/BashOutput/process/input/history/state/replay tool definitions and dispatch, Claude Code configuration with Bash denied and agentsh MCP server, and proactive agentsh SKILL.md.

Added failure-class fixtures, integration coverage for streams/default stdin/timeouts/signals/reconciliation, and reproducible Claude Code context-token benchmark methodology. Local race/vet/full tests pass; Linux cgroup-specific coverage remains capability-gated and was validated separately in the Podman machine.

Added pi.dev TypeScript extension registering agentsh Bash, BashOutput, and BashInput tools, intercepting the competing built-in bash tool, forwarding typed RPC over the workspace Unix socket, lazy-starting the daemon, and documented installation/host limitations in .pi/README.md.
Added agentsh processes CLI subcommand with optional --session filtering, JSON output via existing BashProcesses RPC, usage validation, and empty-process smoke test.

Defined multi-plugin marketplace contract and added root Claude marketplace catalog, agentsh Claude manifest, pi package metadata, shared package layout, installation documentation, validation script, and agentsh package adapter copies. Added .agentsh/ runtime directory to gitignore.
Implemented sparse versioned line-to-byte-offset sidecar indexes for bounded BashOutput lines=A:B paging, with safe fallback, rebuild, and GC cleanup
Removed the shared s.ln listener field; Serve now owns the listener and a watcher goroutine closes it on shutdown, so Shutdown only signals via s.stop. go test -race ./internal/daemon/ passes.

BashOutput grep now uses ripgrep (bounded -m with context) with a pure-Go fallback; line-numbered results, explicit Matches/Omitted/Truncated metadata; tests cover binary data, invalid regex, no matches, and 200k-line logs

Added conservative command family detection and structured result formatting for go test, pytest, jest, cargo, kubectl, and terraform; derived summaries include pass/fail/mutation counts and bounded failure frames; stored in Invocation.Summary and SQLite

Added passive invocation loop detection; tracks near-identical failing commands per session within a configurable window (default 3 in 5m); emits bounded warning with prior invocation IDs in preview; tests cover thresholds, resets, window expiry, and concurrent sessions

Added Drain3-style log template clustering, stack-trace collapse for Go/Python/Node/Rust/Java, log level histograms, baseline comparison with novel/rare template prioritization, and SQLite log_templates persistence queryable via OpBashTemplates and BashOutput(mode=templates)
Created standalone agentsh-analytics binary and pure-Go exporter to Parquet (invocations, templates, errors, test_results) with DuckDB query integration and complete schema/query documentation

All 20 child issues completed: daemon runtime, durable invocation & blob storage, supervision, waiting-on-input detection, sessions & shell state carry-forward, cgroup v2 containment, history/replay APIs, MCP & skill integrations, sparse indexing, bounded rg log search, structured command formatters, Drain3 log template clustering, passive loop detection, DuckDB/Parquet analytics exporter, and data race fixes.

Tests added: internal/rpc/client_test.go, internal/mcp/tools_test.go, internal/mcp/transport_test.go. go vet clean, go test -count=1 ./... passes, -race passes on rpc+mcp.

Tests added: storage/view_test.go, executor/env_baseline_test.go, daemon/singleton_test.go. go vet clean; go test -count=1 -race ./... passes (10 packages).

Fixed in 3446ad1 (plus dfa4416 for the leak/exit-code items). New internal/config package: daemon settings come from --config, then <workspace>/.agentsh/config.json, then ~/.config/agentsh/config.json; supports auth_token or auth_token_file; warns on a credential file readable beyond its owner; missing config is fine, missing explicit path is an error. Daemon no longer reads TURSO_* from its environment — they are ignored with a warning and withheld from supervised commands. Resolves the env-passthrough concern at its source rather than by allowlisting: the daemon's environment no longer holds secrets. Tests: internal/config/config_test.go. go vet clean; go test -count=1 -race ./... EXIT=0 across 11 packages.

Bounded 4 memory sinks: analyzer.AnalyzeReader (capped+streamed blob scan), server.go readTemplates (no more ReadAll), executor control-pipe capped at 4MB w/ reporting, readBlobExcerpt confirmed already bounded. Tests + race pass. Committed 52e4085.

History() single-query fix, GetPriorTemplatesForCommand JOIN replaces unbounded IN clause (tested past 1000 prior invocations), scan errors propagated, schema_version table + versioned migrations added. sql.Open error was already propagated. Tests + race pass. Committed cc62667.

Per-connection ctx derived from server-lifetime ctx, cancelled on client disconnect (goroutine reads conn post-decode) or shutdown; threaded through Execute/History/GetInvocation/Replay/templates. Added executor.terminateRunning (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after Grace) so shutdown can't hang on a stubborn process; background invocations still isolated via their own detached runCtx. Tests: disconnect kills the process, shutdown returns within grace with a long foreground command running. Race-clean. Committed 4de0826.

Added executor.Service/ServiceRequest + StartService/ServiceStatus/KillService/LoadServices, riding on the existing Background-invocation path so services are unaffected by disconnect/shutdown. RPC ops bash_service/bash_service_status/bash_service_kill wired in daemon, persisted as JSON under paths.Services with tmp-then-rename, reconciled at startup. Store interface gained GetInvocation. Tests cover duplicate-name rejection, reuse after kill, crashed vs stopped distinction, unknown-name errors, and restart survival (executor unit tests + daemon RPC integration tests). Race-clean. Committed b9a2e59. BashServiceLogs is dzz.3, readiness predicates dzz.2 — unblocked next.

New internal/service package: Predicate interface (PortPredicate/StdoutRegexPredicate/HTTPPredicate) + BuildPredicates/WaitReady with progressive short-circuit evaluation (port, then regex, then HTTP) and AND semantics across a poll round. Zero predicates = instant success; timeout/cancellation report last-known per-predicate state. Wired into executor.StartService via a new ReadinessSpec field (readiness failure doesn't kill the already-started service) and RPC BashServiceRequest.Readiness. Unit tests in internal/service plus daemon RPC integration tests for blocking-until-ready and timeout-keeps-running. Race-clean, full suite passes. Committed ad862b0.

New bash_service_logs RPC: pages/tails/follows a named service's output via the existing BashOutput machinery (readOutput reused directly for plain/Lines/Grep; Tail computed by reading full text once and slicing; Follow polls OpenRunning until idle timeout/max lines/overall timeout since there's no push transport). ServiceStatus resolves name->invocation and self-heals crashed/stopped state, so non-running services naturally return last output. Deliberately skipped cross-restart log concatenation — Service records only track the current invocation ID, no history to concatenate; needs a real design decision, documented as a follow-up rather than half-implemented. 6 new daemon RPC integration tests (unknown name, line-range paging, tail, non-running, follow-until-idle, follow-max-lines cap). Race-clean, full suite passes. Committed 22af54b.

All 3 children closed: dzz.1 (named service tracking, start/status/kill, restart reconciliation), dzz.2 (port/stdout-regex/HTTP readiness predicates), dzz.3 (BashServiceLogs paging/tail/follow). Acceptance criteria met except cross-restart log concatenation, explicitly descoped in dzz.3's closing notes as needing its own design (Service records don't retain invocation history across restarts/kills). Commits: b9a2e59, ad862b0, 22af54b.

Renamed module github.com/avishai-ish-shalom/sweatshop/agentsh -> github.com/Fewbytes/sweatshop/agentsh in go.mod and all 28 files importing it (go.sum untouched, no dependency changes). Committed 093196c, pushed to Fewbytes/sweatshop:main. Verified end-to-end: go install github.com/Fewbytes/sweatshop/agentsh/cmd/agentshd@main from a clean GOPATH/GOCACHE succeeds and produces a working binary. Cross-check against sweatshop-u7z/sweatshop-1mx (binary distribution, install docs) still pending as separate tickets.

pruneStale() now prunes every session's expired records on every call (not just the currently-touched session), removing empty sessions from the map. Shared sessionAndCommand() helper dedupes the RecordAndCheck/RecordSuccess preamble. In-memory-only limitation documented on LoopDetector per the acceptance criterion's alternative (survive restart OR document). New test proves the map shrinks: 500 stale one-off sessions, then a single unrelated call prunes all of them. Race-clean, full suite passes. Committed 0166cb1.

Rewrote cmd/agentsh/main.go around a command table: each of 16 RPC ops (health/shutdown/bash/output/input/kill/state/history/replay/processes/gc/templates/service/service-status/service-kill/service-logs) has its own flag.FlagSet covering its request struct's fields, no hand-rolled arg scanning. unavailable() now matches only ECONNREFUSED/ENOENT via errors.Is instead of any *net.OpError. Unit tests per build func plus a table test asserting every rpc.Op* is covered; manually smoke-tested the built binary end-to-end (daemon auto-spawn, bash flags, service lifecycle, unknown command). Full suite passes. Committed 1a5ae6f.

go mod tidy: go.mod now has separate direct (parquet-go/parquet-go, tursodatabase/go-libsql) and indirect require blocks; second tidy run confirms no diff. No CI/justfile exists yet to add a tidy gate to (that's sweatshop-1mx's build-tooling scope), noted in commit. Committed 1b3ff0f.

New root justfile (build/test/lint/install/validate-marketplace/ci recipes, all run and verified locally). New .github/workflows/ci.yml runs just lint/test/build/validate-marketplace on push+PR. Fixed packages/agentsh/README.md's placeholder marketplace URL to github.com/Fewbytes/sweatshop, added concrete build+install instructions (both cmd/agentsh and cmd/agentshd), documented AGENTSHD_PATH. CLAUDE.md and README.md point at the justfile. just ci passes clean end-to-end. Committed f724aba.

internal/version package shared by agentsh/agentshd (build-time -ldflags -X); rpc.Health gains Version; mcp serverInfo now reports it instead of a hardcoded '0.1.0'. New 'agentsh doctor' command: binary/daemon version + mismatch check, socket, daemon reachability, DB openability (the actual 'database is locked' incident), platform capability — nonzero exit on real problems. New SessionStart hook (packages/agentsh/hooks/) does a fast presence/runnability check on agentshd and prints an actionable message instead of silence, plus a Bash-deny guardrail check when jq+settings.json available. agentshd gains a runtime platform guard. Doctor and platform-guard behavior covered by tests (live-daemon smoke test, missing-binary case, platformSupported table test). Committed+pushed ce34b4c.

Declared platform matrix (linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64; darwin/amd64 impossible — go-libsql has no prebuilt static lib for it, confirmed by attempting the build; windows unsupported), enforced both at runtime (agentshd refuses to start on an unsupported target) and in the release matrix. New .github/workflows/release.yml: tag-triggered, one native runner per platform (CGO rules out cross-compiling from a single runner — verified locally), builds+archives+checksums+uploads via softprops/action-gh-release. justfile embeds real version/commit via ldflags now. README documents prebuilt-release install and the platform table. Packaging/build steps verified locally end-to-end before committing (no live tag push performed, so the actual GH Actions run itself is unverified — flag if the first real tag reveals an issue). Committed+pushed ce34b4c.

Renamed drain.go->masking.go and updated doc comments to describe masked-hash clustering, not Drain (per the ticket's naming-vs-implementation either/or). Consolidated MaskVariables' 8 sequential full-line regex passes into one combined alternation pass + cheap per-token category check; benchmarked before/after (recorded in masking_test.go): ~5.6x fewer allocs on MaskVariables, ~4-6x fewer on a 100k-line ClusterLines benchmark. Removed numRegex's dead |\b\d+\b alternation branch. Removed the never-set TemplateCluster.IsStackTrace field after verifying ClusterLines only ever sees non-stack-trace lines and analyzer.go sets LogTemplate.IsStackTrace explicitly for both paths. New tests per category + the URL/timestamp precedence case + bare-digit regression. Full suite passes. Committed 3f3e853.

handle() is now a decode+dispatch+encode loop against a map[string]opHandler table, one handleXxx func per op. Generic decodeParams[T]/decodeOptionalParams[T] replace repeated unmarshal boilerplate. Fixed named inconsistency: BashState/BashProcesses/BashGC now report invalid_params on malformed input (previously swallowed with _ =) while still tolerating absent params. OpShutdown's post-response Shutdown() ordering preserved via opHandler returning (Response, func()). BlobStore is now a single Server field instead of 4 inline constructions; digestForStream() deduplicates the stream-name-to-digest switch. All 21 existing daemon tests pass unchanged; added table/invalid-params/digestForStream/unknown-op tests. Race-clean. Committed 8192a00.
